recipes.name: Grilled Salmon Sandwich with Dill Sauce
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 pound) fillet salmon, cut into 2 portions

steps.text: Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate. Evenly coat salmon with olive oil.

Cook on the preheated grill, skin-side down, about 5 minutes; flip and cook on other side until skin easily lifts off flesh, about 5 minutes more. Flip again; continue cooking until salmon flakes easily with a fork, 2 to 3 minutes more.

Whisk mayonnaise, dill, and lemon zest together in a small bowl; divide and spread onto 2 toasted bread slices. Top each with 1 portion salmon, 2 tomato slices, 2 bacon strips, 1 lettuce leaf, and 1 remaining toasted bread slice.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Salmon Sandwich with Dill Sauce
raw_recipe.description: This grilled salmon sandwich with dill sauce recipe uses grilled salmon, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and a simple sauce of dill, lemon zest, and mayonnaise.

review.reviewBody: Delish! I thought the mayo sauce was a tad on the bland side the original way so I modified it to my liking, which is great about recipies! I used the same amount of mayo, 1 tsp of dill, 1/2 tsp lemon pepper, tad bit more cracked black pepper, salt, and it was PERFECT!!!!! I think the lemon pepper was key. Just a few shakes goes a long way. Turkey bacon for a little healther fat, and whole wheat buns, added sauce to fish and to buns.... THANK YOU!! =)

Recipie was OK - can easily be five stars with a few additions:
- season the fish!! I used a cayenne rub to add a little heat 
- don't toast the bread, butter then use the skillet used for the bacon to brown the bread (just drain fat)
- dill sauce: don't sky on zest or dill, 
- three words: pickled red onions!!!

Awesome sandwich! I took the advice of others and used 1/2 tsp lemon pepper rather than the lemon zest. Also added more pepper to the mayo mixture and put some salt and pepper on the salmon too. Put a bit of the mayo on the fish when I grilled it and it just grilled up beautifully! Delicious!
I marinated the salmon in lemon juice, dill, garlic, and olive oil. Also i added some garlic, salt,pepper and lemonjuice to the mayo
I like to season my salmon fillets with Montreal steak seasoning and grill on a cedar plank. Add broccoli sprouts and avocado slices. Perfect served with red potato salad !

Awesome! I did make a few changes to get it a little healthier. I used no-fat mayo and put turkey bacon on it rather than regular bacon. This I prepared by tossing it in the oven rather than in a skillet. For more dill flavor I put chunks of pickle in the sauce as well. Great recipe!!

I made this sandwich and used a toasted ciabatta roll (which made the sandwich perfect) seasoned fish with blacken seasoning. The mayo sauce was good but needed tweeking. Top with lettuce, garden fresh tomato and red onion.. one delicious sandwich
Much better than I thought it would be. Cooked the salmon in the oven (375 for 10 minutes) and added black pepper to the mayo per the other reviews. It was the perfect summer sandwich.
This was an excellent recipe. I made one small change - I applied the sauce to the salmon BEFORE grilling, and also used it as suggested on the sandwich itself. Yum!
Good reviews from the family!! Used cast iron frying pan, buns from freezer, left over greens, and lime instead of lemon. Great last minute decision for weeknight dinner. No bacon but wasn't missed.

We had some leftover wild grilled salmon and made up this sandwich. The sauce was very good, I did make it hours ahead so the flavors had time to meld together. We warmed the salmon. Nice for summer nights.
YUM!
Delicious!
excellent!
Can't really complain! It's a simple sandwich with a lot of flavor! Happy I made it for lunch lol
Probably a matter of taste, but I didn't care for the slight sweetness in the mayo and the lemon tones in this sandwich. It wasn't bad, but not my favorite either.
I have made this a couple of times for my family and both times it was a homerun. This is an easy recipe with great flavors sure to bring smiles to anyone that tries it. Thanks Cathy!
i ate it since young.
Delicious flavor. Loved the sauce.
My first thought was -- salmon on a bun? My second thought --- bacon with salmon?? Glad I tried it. It was messy to eat, and messy on the barbecue, but worth it --- delicious.
